# Droparabia

> Droparabia is the first dropshipping platform built for Lebanon, and soon the wider MENA
> region. Sellers pick products from a vetted catalog, sell them on their own Shopify store,
> and Droparabia handles sourcing, stock, packaging and delivery. Sellers are charged per
> item sold, so there is no inventory to buy upfront.

Droparabia was created to remove the obstacles that cause most e-commerce and dropshipping
businesses to fail before they start: large upfront investments, renting warehouses, buying
stock in bulk that may not sell, sourcing from unreliable suppliers, and finding a delivery
partner. It is aimed at anyone starting an online business, regardless of prior experience,
technical skill or education.

## How it works

1. Integrate your Shopify store with Droparabia, which lets you add and sell any catalog
   product directly on your own website.
2. Droparabia tracks stock and inventory for every product, so you manage no inventory.
3. Droparabia handles packaging and delivery each time a customer orders from your store.
4. You are charged per item sold, so you only pay for what you sold rather than purchasing
   stock.

## Tools

- **Find Products** — a catalog of in-demand, proven products. Filter by niche, order a
  physical sample before committing, and one-click import to Shopify.
- **AI Winning Products** — each product gets an AI score out of 100 across trend,
  competition, margin, saturation, impulse buy and repeat-purchase potential, plus a
  target-audience analysis and a sell recommendation.
- **AI Studio** — generate your own product ad images and videos from your own prompts,
  instead of reusing other creators' content.
- **Branding** — print on demand per sold item, so you build a branded store without paying
  upfront to private-label a bulk order.
- **Product Request** — send an image of a product you want and Droparabia sources it for
  you, with no extra sourcing fee.
- **Leader Board** — see how your store ranks against other sellers, with events, giveaways
  and an affiliate program for top performers.

## Dropvault community

Every Droparabia user is a member of Dropvault, which includes 20+ hours of free courses and
recorded tutorials, weekly coaching calls with advisors, occasional giveaways, and a
dedicated WhatsApp support group.

## Common questions

**Is Droparabia an easy way to make money?**
No. It is for people serious about building a business and ready to put in the effort.
Droparabia makes it easier to start; whether it succeeds depends on your effort.

**Why not just start traditional e-commerce?**
Traditional e-commerce means buying hundreds of products upfront, storing them, and hoping
they sell. Droparabia lets you test products with zero inventory risk first.

**Is there a refund policy?**
Yes. A full refund plus compensation for time and money lost, if a user followed all
instructions and made full use of the platform (with proof provided) but made no sales
within 90 days.

**What if a product isn't in the catalog?**
Use Product Request: send an image of the product and Droparabia will source it without
extra fees.

## Operations

Droparabia runs its own logistics network in Deir Qoubel, Mount Lebanon Governorate, with its
own delivery infrastructure covering Lebanon, plus supplier partners locally and in China.
Founded by Majd Abdulsalam, a digital marketing specialist and e-commerce brand builder.
